title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
The Security Operations Engineer builds and operates security controls, tooling, and automation across DeepHealth 's cloud and corporate environments. This role is responsible for configuring, integrating, and maintaining the enterprise security tooling stack, developing detection content, and automating security operations tasks so that controls are repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable.
Working within DeepHealth 's established security frameworks and under the direction of the Director, Security Operations, this position operates and tunes security controls, detection content, and guardrails. Independent validation of those controls sits with the security operations watch function - a deliberate separation that keeps the control environment defensible under audit. Remediation follows system ownership across Cloud Operations, Platform, and Application Development; this role supplies technical guidance and implements fixes directly where the control is security-owned.
This position operates within a regulated healthcare environment across a global operating footprint, with obligations under HIPAA, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2. The role reports to the Director, Security Operations, with future reporting to the Manager, Security Operations as that position is established.
Requirements

• Build, configure, integrate, and tune the enterprise security tooling stack across cloud and corporate environments.

• Develop and maintain detection content, correlation rules, and response automation within the SIEM and SOAR platform.

• Onboard new log sources and telemetry feeds, validating ingestion completeness, parsing accuracy, and field normalization.

• Administer and tune endpoint detection and response tooling, including policy configuration, exclusion governance, and coverage validation.

• Integrate security tooling with adjacent platforms through APIs to reduce manual handling and improve data quality.

• Implement and maintain security configurations, guardrails, and baselines across Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, and Microsoft Azure.

• Build and maintain security automation and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or an equivalent framework, so that controls are version-controlled, repeatable, and auditable.

• Implement policy-as-code and preventive guardrails using native cloud policy engines or an equivalent open policy framework.

• Support cloud security posture management across all cloud environments, including finding deduplication, theme mapping, and routing to owning teams.

• Harden cloud resources including compute, storage, database, container, and serverless services against established benchmarks.

• Configure and maintain Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls, including conditional access, identity protection, and Defender workloads in a hybrid directory environment.

• Implement and maintain least-privilege access models, roles, and policies across multiple cloud identity systems.

• Implement container and Kubernetes security controls, including role-based access control, workload security standards, image scanning, and runtime protection.

• Implement and maintain secrets management practices and tooling, and support the elimination of hard-coded credentials across environments.

• Operate vulnerability management tooling, validate scan coverage, and translate raw scanner output into prioritized, owner-routed findings.

• Provide technical remediation guidance to cloud, platform, identity, application, and endpoint owners, who retain accountability for closure of findings in their systems.

• Implement engineering fixes for findings that fall to security-owned tooling and configuration.

• Support remediation tracking for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings by supplying technical detail and validating that fixes are technically sound.

• Support incident detection and response through hands-on technical investigation, including log analysis, endpoint examination,

title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
description: The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures. A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant-liner-casing interfaces - combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies. What You’ll Do · Conduct stress analysis using both classical hand-calculation methods and FEA - linear and non-linear, static and dynamic · Simulate solid rocket motor structures: propellant grain stress and strain fields, bond integrity at propellant-liner and liner-casing interfaces, TPS thermomechanical response, and igniter/nozzle attachment loads · Conduct non-linear simulations covering geometric non-linearity, material non-linearity (plasticity, hyperelasticity for propellant and elastomeric materials), and contact mechanics · Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads · Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables · Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly · Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation Requirements What You’ll Need · Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field · 3-5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures · Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for bot

description:

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network - from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Required:

- Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training / relevant hands-on experience

- 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover

- Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation

- Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors

- Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors

- Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation

- Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration

title: PostgreSQL Database Consultant
description:
PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.
JOIN OUR TEAM!
Bitovi is looking for a PostgreSQL Database Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We help enterprise clients run critical data platforms reliably, and we’re looking for people with deep, hands-on PostgreSQL expertise to diagnose, stabilize, and tune large self-managed database environments. If you know Postgres internals well enough to explain why a database fell over and how to make sure it doesn’t happen again, we want to work with you!
Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.
WHO YOU ARE
You’re the person teams call when Postgres is misbehaving in production. You understand what’s happening under the hood, from MVCC and autovacuum to the planner and WAL, and you can turn that understanding into configuration and maintenance changes that keep systems healthy. You’re calm during incidents, rigorous in root cause analysis, and confident communicating findings and recommendations to both engineers and stakeholders.
You’ll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

• Deep, production experience administering PostgreSQL on self-managed, on-premise infrastructure (not only managed services like RDS or Cloud SQL)

• Expert knowledge of vacuum and autovacuum: tuning thresholds and cost limits, diagnosing and remediating table and index bloat, and preventing transaction ID wraparound

• Strong indexing expertise: choosing among B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN, partial, and covering indexes, identifying missing, unused, and duplicate indexes, and rebuilding indexes safely in production

• Mastery of PostgreSQL configuration: memory settings, connection limits, checkpoints, WAL, and planner parameters, and the ability to audit an existing configuration and justify every change

• Query performance analysis using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), pg_stat_statements, and the pg_stat_* views

• Experience with replication and high availability (streaming and logical replication, Patroni, repmgr, or similar) and failover testing

• Backup, restore, and point-in-time recovery experience (pgBackRest, Barman, or similar), including regular restore validation

• Connection pooling with PgBouncer or Pgpool-II

• Monitoring and alerting for Postgres (Prometheus postgres_exporter, pgwatch, Datadog, or similar) focused on catching problems before they become outages

• Solid Linux administration skills as they relate to database hosts: storage, filesystems, kernel parameters, and resource contention

• Incident response and root cause analysis experience, including writing clear postmortems and remediation plans

Other skills we value

• Configuration management for database fleets (Ansible or similar) so settings are consistent, reviewed, and repeatable

• Writing runbooks and maintenance procedures that client teams can own after an engagement

• Capacity planning and performance baselining

• Major version upgrades and schema migrations with minimal downtime

• Working within change management processes in large, regulated enterprises

• Security hardening: roles and privileges, pg_hba configuration, TLS, and auditing (pgAudit)

• Running Postgres on Kubernetes (CloudNativePG, Crunchy Postgres Operator, or similar)

• Scripting and automation in Python, Bash, or Go

• Experience with other relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL)

We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure and data platforms behind them, with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. title: Plumbing Engineer, R&D
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE MECHANICAL ENGINEERING TEAM

You'll join the mechanical engineers in Fluidstack's infrastructure R&D group, who design the cooling, water, and fire systems inside gigawatt-scale AI data centers as repeatable products rather than one-off site designs. Liquid-cooled compute makes water a primary utility: make-up water, treatment, condenser and process loops, and drainage all have to be sized, specified, and standardized so the same design ships to every site.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Standardizing the domestic, process, and make-up water systems that feed liquid cooling plants so they can be ordered as kits and installed in prefabricated modules.

- Sizing water supply, storage, and drainage for cooling loads that swing faster than conventional plumbing design assumes.

- Coordinating water treatment, backflow protection, and chemical dosing with the controls and water-quality engineers who operate the loops.

- Turning field and commissioning findings into design changes that reach the next site.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the plumbing design. Design domestic water, process and make-up water, condenser water piping, drainage, and stormwater systems for data center buildings and prefabricated modules, from concept through construction documents.

- Size and specify. Run hydraulic calculations, select pumps, valves, backflow preventers, water heaters, and storage, and write the specifications vendors and contractors build to.

- Hold the codes. Keep designs compliant with plumbing, mechanical, and health codes across the jurisdictions Fluidstack builds in, and manage the permit and inspection questions that come back.

- Integrate with cooling. Work with the mechanical, water-quality, and controls engineers so make-up water, treatment, and blowdown are designed as one system with the cooling plant.

- Support the build. Review contractor submittals and shop drawings, answer RFIs, and walk installations through commissioning.

title: Reconciliation & Payments Specialist
description:
Description
﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker
This is a hands-on reconciliation role inside Chargeflow 's Billing & Collections team . Money comes in from customers of every size - from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts - across multiple payment channels, and you are the person who makes sure every payment is matched against what the customer was actually invoiced. It's detailed work, it lives largely in Excel, and getting it right matters.
The core of the job is ownership: you reconcile what a customer owes against what they've paid, you close the loop against the invoice we issued, and you don't let it go until it's genuinely resolved - including chasing an open item well after the month has closed. "It'll probably sort itself out" is not part of the role. If a customer hasn't paid their debt, you stay on it until they have.
You'll work across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or simply wrong - so a critical eye is not optional. You need to be the person who notices that two numbers don't agree and cares enough to find out why. It can be frustrating, but the payoff is real: there's genuine satisfaction in untangling a mess and getting it to tie out.
We're also a company that wants to do this smarter over time. You won't be expected to build automation from day one - but we do want someone who is hungry to turn manual, repetitive work into AI-assisted workflows, with Claude as your day-to-day partner for getting there. The role sits within Billing & Collections and reports to the Billing & Collections Manager.
About Chargeflow

Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.
Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.﻿
What You’ll Own
Reconciliation & Collections

• Reconcile customer payments against invoices across the full customer base - from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts.

• Match every incoming payment to what the customer was actually invoiced, and close the loop between the payment received and the invoice issued.

• Investigate every unmatched, partial, or unexpected item down to root cause - don't leave gaps open.

• Track what each customer owes, confirm the debt has actually been paid, and follow up until it's fully resolved - including items that carry past month-end.

• Own your accounts end to end: you're responsible for the reconciliation being clean, correct, and complete, not just started.

• Keep clear, well-documented working papers so anyone can see how a balance was reached.

Working Across the Systems

• Do the heavy lifting in Excel - this is a spreadsheet-intensive role (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets).

• Pull and cross-check data across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or inconsistent.

• Keep a critical eye at all times - assume the data needs verifying, and dig in when two numbers don't agree.

• Take real ownership of the details: notice the discrepancy, care about it, and drive it to a clean answer.

Communication & Responsiveness

• Be responsive to the people who depend on you across the company - Billing, Finance, Operations, and Customer Success.

• Work fluidly across the channels the business runs on: Slack, monday.com, and email.

• When it's the fastest way to resolve something, get on a call with a customer and walk them through their reconciliation directly.

• Explain a billing or reconciliation situation in plain, clea

Content Strategy

title: Head of AI Enablement & Transformation
description:
Head of AI Enablement & Transformation
Voice Systems Engineering (VSE) is a dynamic organization driven by innovation and a shared passion for positively impacting people's lives. We operate multiple brands and businesses, including Psychic Source, Plasma Futures and Soundbed, all focused on mind and body wellbeing, with our flagship brand, Psychic Source, leading the way.
Our vision at VSE centers on the belief that when talented individuals unite, possibilities become limitless. Rooted in a remote-first environment, we've cultivated a culture that embraces diversity, equity, work-life balance, and a true sense of belonging.
For over three decades, VSE has used technology to connect people with expert, caring guidance. We are an established, profitable company, and this year we made a deliberate decision to rebuild the way we work around AI rather than simply adding it to what we already do. Many AI projects are already underway across the business, and the whole company comes together every week to focus on AI adoption. We are now looking for the person to bring that work together and lead it.
We are seeking a passionate, hands-on and experienced Head of AI Enablement & Transformation to turn that commitment into everyday practice across the company. This is a builder's role rather than an advisory one. You should be comfortable prototyping and shipping generative AI agents, automations and the tooling that lets non-engineers use them safely, and equally comfortable teaching a team of roughly forty-five people, most of them non-technical, to apply these tools in their own jobs. You will own the stack, the guardrails and the numbers. You will not have a team reporting to you; the impact of this role comes from forty-five people who can do things they could not do before, working through AI champions across the business, the tools you build and the sessions you run. VSE runs on Holacracy, and this role sits in our General Company Circle, our most senior leadership team, with clearly defined domains that are yours to decide: the tooling stack and its vendors, the skills library and agent registry, and the scorecard and its targets.
Your first priority will be consolidation rather than expansion: bringing the work already underway into one coherent, well-governed program, deciding what to standardize on and what to retire, and putting the right guardrails in place before adding anything new. For the right person, this is the part that determines whether everything that follows succeeds, and the path from this role to real company-wide impact is unusually short.
If you're our new Head of AI Enablement & Transformation, you will look forward to engaging in activities such as:

• Building and shipping AI capabilities: prototypes, agents, evaluation frameworks, and the pipeline that allows a non-engineer to deploy something safely. You will write code most weeks.

• Leading hands-on enablement across the company: a weekly working session you run, role-specific playbooks, office hours, and a network of AI champions in every function, with adoption measured in actual use rather than attendance.

• Redesigning core workflows around what AI makes possible, in partnership with the teams that do the work, rather than automating the steps that already exist.

• Owning the AI scorecard: publishing weekly results including the metrics that missed, setting targets, and being transparent when a target changes and why.

• Deciding the tooling stack: evaluating models, platforms, agent frameworks and vendors; running proofs of concept; making build-versus-buy calls; and avoiding tool sprawl.

• Building the guardrails first: a graduated autonomy model that agents earn on evidence, traceability from every output back to its prompt and approver, a permissions and data-classification model that holds, and acceptable-use policy developed with Legal, HR and IT as partners from week one.

• Managing the use-case pipeline from intake through prioritiza

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Leader who will lead and grow a team of Software Engineers within the Cloud Network Engineering organization. This team is responsible for delivering secure, performant, and easy to operate network observability tooling, for enhancing our DNS management control plane, and customizing host network interface software. The team provides software solutions that ensure consistent network performance throughout the Netflix ecosystem.
This team has reliably enabled Netflix ’s hyper cloud growth by co-innovating with AWS, driving technologies like IPv6, Hybrid infrastructure, and delivering eBPF-based products to create novel solutions to classic problems. If you’re looking for a deeply technical and highly dynamic opportunity that will have an outsized impact on how Netflix scales in the future, we’d love to talk to you!
What you will do:

• Lead a team of stunning software engineers developing network observability, DNS control plane, and network interface software.

• Hire, oversee, and grow software developers.

• Form strong cross-functional partnerships driven by trust to achieve alignment with many engineering teams and ensure our solutions meet their needs, while maintaining our focus on agility, scalability, reliability, and efficiency.

• Build Netflix 's network observability capability, guiding the development of a visibility platform that engineering teams use to understand, debug, and secure their traffic.

• Strong software development focus with past work abstracting away complexity and guiding teams to deliver simple, effective solutions to customers.

• Outcome-focused mindset, consistently thinks from first principles.

• Experience building and operating complex distributed systems at scale. We use AWS; experience with building/consuming the networking stack of a public cloud is a plus.

• Shipping through organizational complexity. Proactively resolves cross-team dependencies, migration sequencing, competing priorities. Builds consensus and influences peer teams to move initiatives forward.

• Solid understanding of Layer3/Layer4 networking, and network security is a plus.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. The range for this role is $436,000.00 - $791,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

Create Music Group is looking for a highly motivated, self-driven Senior Treasury Analyst to help build out our growing Treasury organization. This role owns real-time visibility into Create's global cash across all bank accounts and entities, informs debt facility utilization, and ensures the operational integrity of payments, transfers, and FX spot transactions in a high-growth, multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

Partnering cross-functionally with FP&A, Accounting, Legal, M&A, and other business partners, this individual will run the day-to-day execution of Create's Treasury operations while developing deep expertise in cash and liquidity management. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives amid evolving processes, brings a bias toward precision on high-stakes work, and is eager to take on a highly visible role at one of the music industry's fastest-growing companies.

Responsibilities

• Own Create’s daily cash position across all bank accounts and entities, identifying funding needs and surplus balances at a global scale

What You Will Do

• Design and execute rigorous quantitative and qualitative research, including panel studies, surveys, focus groups and appropriate AI-enabled research methodologies.

• Analyse and interpret data to produce clear, unbiased and commercially relevant insights.

• Translate insights into specific recommendations, explaining the expected business opportunity, supporting evidence, risks and proposed success metrics.

• Facilitate decision sessions with relevant stakeholders and ensure that each recommendation is accepted, rejected or deferred with a documented rationale.

• Co-create action plans in which every approved recommendation has a named business owner, deadline and success metric. The business owner remains accountable for implementation.

• Follow up on agreed actions, measure the results of implemented recommendations and capture lessons for future decision-making.

• Lead a monthly Research Council, sponsored by the CMO, to prioritise research, review findings, make decisions and track the outcomes of previously approved recommendations.

How Success Will Be Measured
Success will be assessed through:

• the strategic relevance and methodological quality of the research portfolio;

• the clarity, timeliness and actionability of recommendations;

• the percentage of completed projects that result in an explicit business decision;

• stakeholder satisfaction with the quality of the partnership and recommendations;

• the percentage of approved recommendations with a named owner, deadline and success metric;

• the measured contribution of implemented recommendations to conversion, retention, brand performance, customer experience or revenue.

The Senior Consumer & Marketing Insights Manager contributes to business impact through better decisions but is not solely accountable for outcomes that depend on implementation by other teams.
Requirements

•
Who You Are:

title: Sr Cash Accountant

Overview
The Senior Cash Accountant supports centralized cash management by reconciling bank accounts, recording cash activity, resolving variances, and maintaining audit-ready documentation. This role partners with Accounting, Treasury, Patient Financial Services, Grants, Payroll, and operational teams to ensure cash transactions are accurate, timely, and properly recorded while supporting process improvement and automation. Lead or support automation initiatives, system implementations, and process improvements related to cash management operations. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is the central operational hub for protecting our people, facilities, executives, operations, and critical business interests around the world. We are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Sr. Manager to lead the continued evolution of this capability. You will inherit a capable GSOC with a strong operational foundation and take it forward, defining what the function becomes next across people, technology, process, analytics, and data.
You will pair strong real-time operational leadership with a track record of materially advancing a GSOC, command center, emergency operations center, or comparable 24/7 environment. You will work alongside Global Threat Intelligence and in close partnership with Information Security, Executive Protection, and other risk functions to deliver a converged, intelligence-informed security operation.

 

What You’ll Do

Location: Onsite out of our Scottsdale Headquarters 
Reports to: Director, Global Security

Set the Vision

• Establish and execute a multi-year roadmap for the GSOC across people, technology, process, analytics, and data.

• Assess the current operating model, identify gaps and opportunities, and set clear modernization priorities.

• Translate enterprise risk, business growth, and emerging threats into scalable GSOC capabilities.

• Define measurable goals, milestones, and performance indicators that demonstrate operational maturity and business value.

• Evaluate industry best practices and emerging technologies to keep the GSOC modern and highly capable.

Lead the GSOC

• Provide strategic and operational leadership for the 24/7/365 GSOC, ensuring consistent, high-quality monitoring, incident management, communications, escalation, and response.

• Maintain clear standards for shift operations, pass-downs, escalation protocols, documentation, and incident reporting.

• Ensure personnel maintain situational awareness across Axon’s global footprint and deliver timely, actionable information to stakeholders.

• Establish decision rights and escalation thresholds for routine and critical events, with appropriate leadership coverage across all shifts and time zones.

• Develop and maintain policies, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Transform Technology and Process

• Lead continuous improvement of the operating model, simplifying, automating, and integrating existing capabilities.

title: Regional Director, Mid-Market, NYC
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will lead one of the pioneer Mid-Market sales teams from the front. You own a team of Account Executives selling to engineering organizations under 3,000 employees, and you carry the number for the region. You will also anchor and help scale our San Francisco & New York City offices, hiring, ramping, and building the culture of the first and second GTM hubs.

You will lead a team of Mid-Market Account Executives who run technical, multi-stakeholder sales cycles into engineering organizations, selling Factory's Droids to CIOs, CTOs, engineering leaders, and procurement. This is a player-coach role for someone who has carried a bag, hit the number, and then built the team that does it repeatedly. You coach deals daily, run a tight forecast, and raise the bar on talent.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Own Mid-Market team revenue. Hit and exceed quarterly new-logo and expansion targets with the majority of reps hitting quota.

- Lead a team of 6-8 Mid-Market AEs. Hire, onboard, ramp, coach, and performance-manage.

- Coach end-to-end Mid-Market cycles: pipeline generation, technical evaluations and POCs, multi-stakeholder navigation across CIOs, CTOs, engineering leaders, and procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

- Run an accurate weekly forecast and a healthy, inspected pipeline. No surprises.

- Help build/scale the playbook: refine the outbound motion, POC-to-close conversion, and the path from self-serve to enterprise.

- Anchor the SF & NYC offices. Establish the in-person sales culture, rituals, and bar for the first and second hubs.

- Partner with the CEO, Sales Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and RevOps to customize solutions, drive expansion and renewal, and compound pipeline.

- Model the work. Get in deals, talk to engineering leaders, and stay fluent in how Factory creates value.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with 2+ years leading a quota-carrying team as a first-line manager, ideally in Mid-Market with complex, multi-stakeholder cycles.

- A track record of personally carrying and exceeding quota before moving into leadership.

- Proven success selling technical products to engineering buyers (developer tools, DevOps, infrastructure, or platform software strongly preferred).

- Experience building or scaling a team or office from an early stage. You have hired and ramped reps, not just inherited them.

- Command of forecasting, pipeline inspection, and sales process. You run on data.

- A coaching instinct and the technical aptitude to coach evaluations and demos for DevEx and engineering buyers. Your reps get better because of you.

Nice to Have

- Experience selling AI or agentic products to technical buyers.

- Early-stage or founding GTM experience (Series A/B).

- An existing network among mid-market engineering leaders.

This is an in-office position, 5 days a week, based in NYC.

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. title: Channel Enablement Manager
description:
About the Role
Through the channel, a great product only wins when the partner knows how to sell it. At Abnormal, we want every partner ready to lead with the whole platform.
Abnormal is a channel-first company: nearly all of our transactions run through partners, which makes partner readiness a direct driver of revenue. As Channel Enablement Manager, you will own how our reseller, distributor, and referral partners learn to position, sell, and support the full Abnormal platform, and how our internal sellers work alongside them. We are expanding from email security into a multi-product behavioral platform spanning Identity, Insider Risk, and AI Security, so partners need to lead with the platform and grow every customer over time. You will be the person who makes that possible.
This is a high-visibility individual contributor role on the Sales Enablement team, working closely with Channel Leadership, Channel Account Managers (CAMs), and Channel SEs. You will build scalable, role-based partner enablement and certifications, deliver training people remember, and use data to prove that enabled partners generate more pipeline and win more deals. It is a role for someone who loves the craft of helping others succeed and wants to bring AI to the center of how enablement scales.
What You Will Do

•
Build the framework. Design, build, and deliver a role-based partner enablement framework (Partner Essentials, Partner Sales 101, Pre-Sales 101, and advanced modules) through the Partner Portal and live sessions.

•
Get partners productive faster. Lead partner onboarding that takes new and focus partners from signed to productive, with clear readiness milestones and certification paths.

•
Train with impact. Deliver engaging in-person and virtual training to partner sellers, SEs, and leaders on Abnormal's value proposition, SEG displacement, discovery, qualification, and competitive positioning.

•
Teach partners to sell the platform. Enable partners to sell Abnormal as a platform, with clear land-and-expand plays, cross-sell motions, and readiness for every new product launch.

•
Prepare our own teams to co-sell. Enable Abnormal AEs, SDRs, and SEs on how to work with partners, including rules of engagement, deal registration, channel discounts, and renewal incumbency.

•
Create the assets partners use. Partner with CAMs, Channel SEs, Channel Ops, Channel Marketing, and Product Marketing to deliver partner-facing sales plays, use cases, win wires, campaigns-in-a-box, and competitive intelligence.

•
Let the data steer. Use performance data (partner-sourced pipeline, deal reg conversion, certification completion, win rates) to find gaps, prioritize investments, and report measurable impact.

•
Scale with AI. Use AI to scale enablement and reduce CAM 1:1 training time, through AI-assisted content, roleplays, and on-demand coaching, so CAMs can focus on pipeline generation and partner-sourced revenue.

Must Haves

• 5 to 8+ years in channel sales, partner management, sales, or a sales-supporting role (for example, channel/partner enablement, CAM, channel SE, sales enablement), with a track record of individual success and/or developing others.

• Direct experience working with or enabling channel partners (VARs, resellers, distributors, MSPs, or referral partners) in a B2B SaaS environment, a solid understanding of how partners make money and decide which vendors to champion, and the credibility to influence partner sellers and internal AEs on co-selling, deal registration, and channel conflict.

• Experience designing and running scalable enablement: certifications, on-demand courses, LMS/partner portal content, and live training.

• A genuine desire to help others succeed, with a sense of accomplishment tied to partner and field performance as much as your own.

• A strong analytical mindset. You use data to diagnose performance and prioritize enablement, and can describe past examples of how data drove change.

• Outstanding communication
